info.name: ActionBridge - Invoice API
info.description:
Complete API collection for submitting invoices with multiple line items to ActionBridge.

Base URL: https://actionbridge.bnfkquodqjp.uk

## Flow:
1. Check Setup → Run Setup (first time only)
2. Login → Get JWT token
3. Create Project
4. Create Invoice Document Type (with line_items table)
5. Submit invoices with line items
6. List / Export documents
